name: Morekabe ~Komorebi no Namikimichi Kabegami Shuu~
original_name: もれかべ ～木漏れ日の並木道壁紙集～
source:
Disc contains mini adventure:
Even though indecisive main character gets seduced by apartment residents, is it possible for him to deepen relations with Ayase Shion and take her to the altar? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
光盘中收录一部迷你冒险故事：
优柔寡断的主人公虽然受到公寓住户们的诱惑，最终是否仍能加深与绫濑紫苑的感情，和她一同走上婚礼红毯？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
